zh.title: 第一次创建终端
zh.scene: 默认推荐配置；打开 Ctrl+F，列表包含 New Terminal；另截 Create Terminal 表单，填 first-session，保留本地 server 和默认 shell。
zh.purpose: 识别创建入口与需要填写的字段；不要放配对凭据。

en.title: Create the first terminal
en.scene: Use the supplied profile. Show Ctrl+F with New Terminal, then the Create Terminal form with first-session and local/default shell.
en.purpose: Identify the entry point and fields; exclude credentials.

zh.title: TUI 工作台区域
zh.scene: 同屏显示 workspace、两个 tab、左右两个 panel 和底部快捷键；标注当前焦点、终端名与设备。
zh.purpose: 分清布局、任务与默认操作入口。

en.title: Workbench regions
en.scene: Show a workspace, two tabs, two panels and the footer; label focus, terminal name and endpoint.
en.purpose: Distinguish layout, tasks and default controls.

zh.title: 选择器与终端管理器
zh.scene: 准备 3 个演示任务，含运行、退出、kind=task 标签；分别截 Ctrl+F 选择器和 Ctrl+G → p 管理器，保留右侧预览。
zh.purpose: 说明快速切换和任务检查的区别，展示状态、标签与资源信息。

en.title: Picker and terminal manager
en.scene: Prepare three demo tasks with running/exited states and kind=task tags; capture the picker and manager with preview.
en.purpose: Compare switching with inspection and show state, tags and resources.

zh.title: 分屏与浮动窗口
zh.scene: 同一 workspace 内两个平铺终端、一个已打开的浮动日志窗口；再截浮动窗口收起后的状态。
zh.purpose: 展示平铺、浮动和收起不等于停止进程。

en.title: Splits and floating views
en.scene: Show two tiled terminals and an open floating log view, then the collapsed float.
en.purpose: Show that arranging or collapsing a view does not stop its task.

zh.title: 历史选择与搜索
zh.scene: 演示日志输出后进入历史模式；搜索 ERROR 并显示上下文，再选中两行；不使用真实业务日志。
zh.purpose: 区分搜索命中、文本选择和 Live。

en.title: History selection and search
en.scene: Use synthetic logs, search ERROR with context, then select two lines in history.
en.purpose: Distinguish a search result, text selection and Live.

zh.title: TUI 连接管理
zh.scene: Ctrl+G → e，选中一个脱敏 SSH 或 Direct 演示 endpoint；包含连接状态与右侧 route 信息。
zh.purpose: 说明设备状态与网络路径；隐去地址、身份指纹等真实资料。

en.title: TUI connections
en.scene: Open Ctrl+G → e and select a synthetic SSH or Direct endpoint with status and route details.
en.purpose: Explain endpoint state and path without real addresses or fingerprints.

zh.title: 配置前后对照
zh.scene: 固定同一布局，分别使用基础配置与教程中的配色示例；保证截图尺寸相同。
zh.purpose: 让读者直接看到 theme、chrome、footer 修改的作用范围。

en.title: Appearance before and after
en.scene: Use the same layout and dimensions with the minimal profile and the tutorial color example.
en.purpose: Show which parts of theme, chrome and footer change.

zh.title: 尺寸控制状态
zh.scene: 电脑和手机同时打开演示终端；截 TUI 的 owner/follow/尺寸锁定提示和对应手机画面。
zh.purpose: 说明查看同一任务与控制其尺寸的区别。

en.title: Resize ownership
en.scene: Open one demo terminal on desktop and phone; capture owner/follow/lock indicators and the phone view.
en.purpose: Explain viewing versus controlling terminal dimensions.

zh.title: App 配对入口
zh.scene: 设备页右上角扫码配对入口及粘贴面板；二维码和 claim 区域留空或打码。
zh.purpose: 帮助新用户找到扫码和粘贴两种入口。

en.title: App pairing entry
en.scene: Show the scanner entry and paste panel; leave claims and QR codes blank or redacted.
en.purpose: Locate scanning and pasting without exposing pairing material.

zh.title: 设备与网络连接
zh.scene: 演示设备的更多操作面板，显示网络连接、默认设备与断开；另截网络详情中的实际路径。
zh.purpose: 区分编辑设备、查看线路、断开和移除。

en.title: Devices and routes
en.scene: Show demo device actions and network details including the actual path.
en.purpose: Distinguish editing, routes, disconnecting and removing.

zh.title: App 终端列表与创建
zh.scene: 终端列表中有运行和退出任务，打开新建终端面板，展示名称、命令、目录和尺寸策略。
zh.purpose: 明确手机端也能创建任务，并说明字段属于目标主机。

en.title: App terminal list and creation
en.scene: Show running and exited tasks and the creation form with name, command, directory and size policy.
en.purpose: Show task creation on mobile and host-side field meanings.

zh.title: 键盘与花瓣菜单
zh.scene: 使用默认键盘显示终端和扩展键；另截长按花瓣菜单及设置中的动作编辑器。
zh.purpose: 展示普通文字、特殊按键与自定义动作的入口。

en.title: Keyboard and petal menu
en.scene: Show the software keyboard and extra keys, a long-press menu and its action editor.
en.purpose: Locate text input, special keys and custom actions.

zh.title: App 显示与设置
zh.scene: 设置页显示字体、字号、终端主题、键盘模式与自动接管尺寸；另截主题预览。
zh.purpose: 区分应用外观、终端配色和终端尺寸。

en.title: App display settings
en.scene: Show font, size, theme, keyboard mode and automatic size takeover settings plus a theme preview.
en.purpose: Separate App appearance, terminal colors and terminal size.

zh.title: 文件浏览与传输
zh.scene: 演示目录包含 build.log、report.json、sample.png；显示单文件菜单和传输任务，不使用个人目录。
zh.purpose: 展示预览、下载、路径复制与传输状态。

en.title: File browsing and transfers
en.scene: Show synthetic build.log, report.json and sample.png, the file menu and transfer list.
en.purpose: Show preview, download, copy path and transfer status.

zh.title: 后台与平板布局
zh.scene: 截后台保持连接、终端通知设置；平板另截 App 自身 Split below 的两终端视图。
zh.purpose: 区分后台连接、通知权限、App 内分屏与系统分屏。

en.title: Background and tablet layout
en.scene: Capture background/notification settings and the App’s own Split below view on a tablet.
en.purpose: Separate background connection, notification permission and App/system splits.
